p: because of you: Your eyes bearing witness.
them from before you: Which yet remain and are not overcome, as in Jos 13:2.
remain among you: And not yet subdued.
nor cause to swear by them: Let not the judges admit an oath which any shall swear by their idols.
eyes: Meaning, they will be a continual grief to you, and so the cause of your destruction.
going the way of all the: I die according to the course of nature.
hearts and in all your souls: Most certainly.
transgressed the covenant of the LORD: He shows that no evil can come to man, except he offend God by disobedience.
